items.title: [Steam论坛] I miss the exploration in story mode
items.summary: I really wish they could give us the option to turn exploration on or off in the story because that was one of the things I really enjoyed, and it made it feel different from other visual novel games in the sense that it gave you a small amount of freedom and control making it feel less linear....
